# X-Tech Enterprises, LLC

> Business transformation consultancy in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma (serving clients nationwide since 1997). X-Tech helps business owners and executives turn manual, legacy operations into automated, AI-powered systems — combining digital transformation strategy, intelligent automation, disciplined change management, and hands-on enterprise software implementation with SLA-backed support.

Contact: sales@x-tech.tv · +1-405-247-0083 · https://x-tech.tv

## What X-Tech does

- Laserfiche consulting and implementation (flagship practice): hundreds of implementations over 18+ years for organizations from 2 to 20,000 employees — deployment, migration, forms and workflow automation, records management design, compliance-driven systems (CJIS, HIPAA, FERPA, COPPA, CCPA, GDPR), and SLA-backed support. https://x-tech.tv/laserfiche.html
- Fractional CIO / fractional COO executive services: part-time, executive-level technology and operations leadership — strategy, vendor governance, and compliance oversight for businesses that need executive judgment without a full-time hire. https://x-tech.tv/fractional-executive.html
- Business transformation consulting for small and medium businesses: digital transformation strategy, legacy system modernization, change management and training, and process optimization. https://x-tech.tv/services.html#smb-support
- Enterprise software implementation and support: Google Workspace, Hyland OnBase, DocuSign, OneSpan Sign (flagship eSignature), Grooper and other intelligent document processing platforms, and AI platform integrations (Copilot, Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude). https://x-tech.tv/services.html#channel-partner
- Consultant enablement: methodology development, sales and proposal support, project pricing, technical architecture reviews, and AI strategy for other consulting practices. https://x-tech.tv/services.html#consultant-consultation
- Corporate DNA™: X-Tech's proprietary operational diagnostic that sequences a company's systems, processes, pain points, and goals into a single interactive visual that becomes a transformation roadmap. Available by private briefing. https://x-tech.tv/#dna

## How X-Tech works

Four phases: Diagnose (map the operation and quantify ROI before commitment), Pilot (prove the solution on a low-risk slice), Standardize (turn what works into trained, repeatable practice), Scale (roll out with governance and SLA-backed accountability).
